query.statement: INSERT INTO TB_RELEASEPLAN (RELEASEPLAN_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, SYSDATE, ?, SYSDATE)
SELECT RELEASEPLAN_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, UPDATED_AT FROM TB_RELEASEPLAN WHERE NAME LIKE '%' || ? || '%' AND STATUS_CD = ? ORDER BY UPDATED_AT DESC
SELECT RELEASEPLAN_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT FROM TB_RELEASEPLAN WHERE RELEASEPLAN_ID = ?
UPDATE TB_RELEASEPLAN SET NAME = ?, STATUS_CD = ?, UPDATED_BY = ?, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE RELEASEPLAN_ID = ?
